pressureAdjoint.scope: Offline assembled potential adjoint for actual saved native quadratic and direct midpoint transport, including the determinant derivative. Controls are native fine-grid velocity and shared projected coarse faces; provisional coarse faces and branch labels are fixed. This is a constructive force operator for this smooth control space, not a solved inertia/pressure system, runtime force application, collision/topology event, performance result or machine acceptance.

inertiaCorrection.scope: Offline nonlinear pressure correction on an actual saved native post-pressure field. Fine-grid inertia is the captured P2G nodal mass times the known parcel rest mass. Projected and provisional coarse-face velocities are held fixed, existing pressure is already present in the saved field, and cell branches and one-pocket topology are restricted. This is neither a replacement runtime pressure solver nor a second liquid simulation. It does not certify contacts, general gas motion, machine acceptance or speed.

inertiaApplication.scope: One correction applied to actual native fine-grid velocity, then actual native G2P and collision without particle position injection. Exact original pressure, mass, transport, particle start positions and uniform inputs are guarded before correction. Existing released pressure remains present and projected/provisional coarse faces stay fixed. Sharp geometry, gas inventory and energy are evaluated offline. This is not a coupled runtime gas/pressure replacement, general retention, performance or machine acceptance.
